constraints: Do not edit, commit, push, comment, merge, publish, or release.
Do not run tests, builds, formatters, or probes unless the parent explicitly authorizes a genuinely new check.
Do not access or modify the issue tracker unless the user explicitly authorizes it for this review.

lanes.task: Trace the changed lifecycle and report introduced correctness or fail-closed defects only.
Audit public, durable, CLI, and migration compatibility against real consumers.
Audit regression coverage, cancellation, resource bounds, portability, and operational invariants.
